verdict.rationale: Runloop documents an official CLI, `rli`, with both an interactive terminal UI and traditional commands for managing resources. Documented uses include creating blueprints from Dockerfiles, SSH into devboxes with automatic key setup, and submitting benchmark jobs that compare agents side-by-side with one command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances such as machine-readable output or a full command reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Runloop CLI (`rli`) provides both an interactive terminal UI and traditional CLI commands for managing your Runloop resources.
The CLI handles all the SSH key setup and connection details automatically.
Submit a benchmark job via the CLI and let Runloop handle everything: provisioning devboxes, running agents, scoring results, and aggregating outputs.
